    MD29A is representation-infinite #

    [mild] figure 2.9 (first diagram): the square a → x → a, a → y → a (η γ = α ω') with arms c → a (the last arrow of γ), x → b (δ) and b → y (β).

    A one-parameter family of bricks of dimension the null root of the Euler form, with integral certificates for "endomorphisms are scalars" and "maps between different members vanish at one vertex".
